notes: Short: highly regulated coastal command node managing port security analytics; cannot allow cloud egress, must be physically air-gapped from public internet.
Security: "We cannot accept any outbound telemetry or automatic updates — all binaries must be signed and hash-verified offline." — Head of Cybersecurity (paraphrase).
Hardware: customer will provide three A100-class nodes and an HSM rack (FIPS 140-3). Redwood must supply install artifacts, model artifacts signed, and an offline package for model updates.
Model preferences: open-family models preferred (Llama-family, Mistral) but must support quantized 8-bit runtime; provenance and license metadata required in SBOM.

Performance targets: p95 latency <=150ms for short chat paths (<=512 tokens) in on-prem cluster; 20 concurrent analyst sessions without degraded quality; throughput target ~250 requests/min sustained.
POC success metrics: functional parity with hosted API for prompt/response patterns; no unintended outbound connections during 72h soak; operator UX for model rollbacks within 15 min.
Compliance asks: manual patching policy, install-runbook signed, audit log retention 7 years, SSO/SAML integration to central IdP via isolated connector, support for on-prem KMS/HSM.
Ops note: ops team wants ability to pin model versions and an offline fallback model binary for emergency rollback. Also asked for a small local eval harness that runs without internet.

Commercial: modest price sensitivity — prefer capex for private deployment but expect Redwood to provide controlled scope for SOW. Estimated ARR discussed ~USD 200k-1M depending on multi-year support.
Blocker details: procurement requires signed evidence of 'no-call-home' before hardware handoff; security wants network segmentation test plan and one-week staging window.

Next actions (choppy): Redwood to provide: 1) Offline install artifact bundle, 2) Signed sample model binary + verification tooling, 3) Detailed SOW w/ escalation matrix, 4) On-site install plan for March POC.

Stated competitive position: they are considering an internal build (modest appetite) and SecureEdge Systems (on-prem specialist). Value prop to emphasize: unified rollout/rollback, observability without telemetry egress, signed artifacts + SBOM.
Sales tip: focus on compliance artifacts (SBOM, signed models), explicit egress-proof installation, and low-touch operator workflows. Bring legal + security SME into next call.
